faq.q: What does "under $1.2M" actually cover on this page?
faq.a: A City of Mission–wide townhome feed with a $1.2M price ceiling, spanning the board sub-areas "Mission" and "Mission-West" on its first page — and, at reading, including detached-form homes inside strata complexes such as Heritage Park Place, so check each listing's form rather than assuming townhouse construction.

faq.q: What is the median price of a Mission townhome?
faq.a: SnapStats publishes no townhome-only median — its attached split is "Condos & Townhomes" combined, at community level only: Mission's combined median was $430,000 in September 2026 on 10 sales (it was $642,500 in August on 12 sales, so treat it as volatile small-count data), and no under-$1.2M band median exists in the source (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Are townhomes in Mission freehold or strata?
faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.

faq.q: What should I check on a townhome in Mission?
faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.
